Ogni colonna ha controllo per rimuovere quella data dalla pianificazione del mese. Desktop-first, scroll orizzontale. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-02-admin-editor-turni-design.md (sez. 6.1). validation.criteria: VERIFIED by independent review: MonthPicker.tsx (src/components/admin/MonthPicker.tsx) is a month+year selector that emits YYYY-MM via onChange. AdminEditor.tsx (src/components/admin/AdminEditor.tsx) fetches config.json, computes allDates = monthDates(month, config.validDayOfWeek) and title = monthTitle(month). The real public config.json has validDayOfWeek = ['Friday','Sunday'], so selecting month 2026-06 produces dates 2026-06-05, 07, 12, 14, 19, 21, 26, 28 (matching src/utils/__tests__/monthDates.test.ts, which passes), and title = 'Turni di Giugno 2026' (also asserted and passing). Removal logic verified by reading code: dateColumns = useMemo(() => allDates.filter(date => !removedSet.has(date))), where removedSet is derived from removedDatesByMonth[month]; handleRemoveDate appends the clicked date via a functional state update (setRemovedDatesByMonth(prev => ({...prev, [month]: [...(prev[month] ?? []), date]}))). This correctly removes the corresponding column from the grid on click, keyed per-month so switching months does not leak removals. Build verified: init.ps1 build runs tsc -b and vite build successfully with no type errors, dist output generated. Tests verified: npm test (vitest run) - 6 test files, 30 tests, all passed.

issues.title: feat: admin ShiftGrid + ShiftCell (slot, dropdown filtrato, colore, assenti disabilitati)
issues.description: Griglia: righe = per ogni ruolo in availableRoles, roleSlots[role] righe (es. Voce 1..5) con etichette italiane; colonne = date. ShiftCell = dropdown con le persone che hanno quel ruolo (availableTeamMembers.roles include role) + opzione vuoto; sfondo/segno cella col colore persona. Persone assenti nella data (da absences) disabilitate/grigie. Lo stato della griglia costruisce le shifts di MonthData. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-02-admin-editor-turni-design.md (sez. 6.2). Dipendenze: MonthPicker/date, config, tipi.

validation.criteria: VERIFIED by independent code read (not just comments) + build/test run. (1) righe rispettano roleSlots: ShiftGrid.tsx buildGridRows() loops config.availableRoles and pushes roleSlots[role] rows each; with public/config.json roleSlots {guitar:1,keyboard:1,drums:1,bass:1,vocals:5} this yields 9 rows total, vocals rows labeled 'Voce 1'..'Voce 5' (roleLabels.vocals='Voce' from src/utils/iconMapper.ts), single-slot roles unnumbered. (2) dropdown filtrato: ShiftGrid builds peopleByRole via config.availableTeamMembers.filter(m => m.roles.includes(role)) and passes only that filtered array as ShiftCell's `people` prop; ShiftCell renders options solely from `people` (e.g. Voce rows only ever show Manuela/Natalia/Magdy/David, never Diego/Samuele/Daniele/Beppe). (3) assenti disabilitati: ShiftGrid computes absentNames=new Set(absences[date]) per cell and passes to ShiftCell, which sets `disabled={absentNames.has(person.name)}` on each <option> (labeled '(assente)'). (4) selezione aggiorna shifts: ShiftCell.onChange -> ShiftGrid.onSelectionChange(key,name) -> AdminEditor.handleSelectionChange writes into selectionsByMonth state; shifts is derived via useMemo(shiftsFromSelections(dateColumns, buildGridRows(config), selections)), a pure projection off that state, so every selection change re-derives MonthData.shifts. (5) colore cella corretto: ShiftCell finds selectedMember in the (role-filtered) people list by name, maps member.color through CELL_COLOR_CLASSES (bg-team-<color>/50) which is a strict subset of the team-* palette defined in tailwind.config.js (yellow/blue/green/red/orange/pink/purple/cyan/brown/gray) -- all 9 config.json member colors resolve correctly; empty selection falls back to bg-white. Build: `.\init.ps1 build` -> tsc -b && vite build succeeded (dist output generated, no type errors). Tests: `npm test` -> 6 test files, 30/30 passed (note: existing tests are util-level only, e.g. src/utils/__tests__/*; no dedicated ShiftGrid/ShiftCell unit tests exist yet, but no regressions and manual logic trace confirms correctness).

issues.title: feat: admin AbsencePanel (assenze per data -> absences)
issues.description: Pannello assenze: per ogni data del mese, multi-select delle persone assenti; aggiorna absences (mappa date->nomi) in MonthData. validation.criteria: VERIFIED by independent code trace: (1) src/components/admin/AbsencePanel.tsx renders one checkbox per (date, roster member); onChange calls onToggle(date, member.name). (2) src/components/admin/AdminEditor.tsx owns `absencesByMonth` state; `absences = absencesByMonth[month] ?? {}` is passed as the SAME object to both <ShiftGrid absences={absences}> (line 199) and <AbsencePanel absences={absences}> (line 210) -- confirmed single source of truth, no parallel absences state. handleAbsenceToggle (line 106-123) adds/removes `name` from `absences[date]` array, pruning the date key entirely when the array empties. (3) src/components/admin/ShiftGrid.tsx builds `absentNames = new Set(absences[date] ?? [])` per date column (line 125) and passes it to ShiftCell as `absentNames` prop. src/components/admin/ShiftCell.tsx renders each <option disabled={absentNames.has(person.name)}> plus an '(assente)' suffix (line 61-64) -- so toggling absence in the panel immediately disables that person's option in the grid for that date. (4) `absences` type is Record<string,string[]>, identical to MonthData.absences in src/types/index.ts (line 34: 'date -> nomi assenti'), so the same shape persists directly into the exported month model with no transform needed. Build: `.\init.ps1 build` -> tsc -b && vite build succeeded (dist output generated). Tests: `npm test` -> 30/30 passed across 6 files (no dedicated AbsencePanel test file exists, but nothing regressed).

issues.title: feat: admin StatsPanel + WarningsPanel (conteggi live + warning)
issues.description: StatsPanel: lista persone con numero turni assegnati nel mese, ricalcolo live (util shiftStats). WarningsPanel: elenco warning non bloccanti (slot vuoti, doppione stesso giorno, assente assegnato) da shiftStats; non impediscono l'export. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-02-admin-editor-turni-design.md (sez. 6.4, 6.5). Dipendenze: shiftStats, ShiftGrid, AbsencePanel.

validation.criteria: VERIFIED (independent review). (1) Conteggi live: AdminEditor.tsx builds monthData via useMemo([title,month,shifts,absences]) then stats via useMemo(() => shiftStats(config, monthData), [config, monthData]) (lines 141-149) -- shifts is itself derived live from `selections` (the grid's source of truth) via shiftsFromSelections, so any assignment/removal in ShiftGrid or any AbsencePanel toggle changes `shifts`/`absences` -> monthData -> stats recomputes -> StatsPanel/WarningsPanel re-render with new counts, confirmed by reading the full useMemo dependency chain. (2) shiftStats.ts exports shiftStats(config: AppConfig, month: MonthData): {counts: ShiftCount[], warnings: ShiftWarning[]} -- exact signature and return shape match the AdminEditor call site (stats.counts, stats.warnings consumed directly by StatsPanel/WarningsPanel props). (3) All 3 warning kinds present and surfaced: WarningType.EMPTY_SLOT (role under-filled vs config.roleSlots), DUPLICATE_SAME_DAY (same name twice same date), ABSENT_ASSIGNED (assigned while absent) -- all computed in shiftWarnings() and all 3 have entries in WarningsPanel.tsx's WARNING_LABELS map (Slot vuoto / Doppia assegnazione / Assente ma assegnato), each covered by its own passing unit test in shiftStats.test.ts. (4) Non-blocking confirmed: grepped src/components/admin for `disabled`/`stats.warnings`/`warnings.length` -- the only `disabled` usage is ShiftCell.tsx's dropdown option (absentee greying, unrelated to warnings); WarningsPanel only uses warnings.length to switch between an empty-state message and the list, never to disable anything; no gating of ShiftGrid, AbsencePanel, or any export/action control based on stats.warnings anywhere in the codebase. (5) `.\init.ps1 build` succeeded (tsc -b && vite build, dist/ generated, no errors). `npm test` succeeded: 6 test files, 30 tests passed, including dedicated shiftCounts and shiftWarnings (all 3 kinds + clean-dataset) tests in src/utils/__tests__/shiftStats.test.ts.

issues.title: feat: AdminEditor wiring (autosave bozza, export, import)
issues.description: Collegare i pezzi in AdminEditor: autosave della bozza MonthData in localStorage per mese (util draftStorage); all'apertura, se esiste bozza, proporre Riprendi/Scarta. Bottone Esporta => scarica turni.json (util exportImport). Bottone Importa turni.json => carica file dal disco e ripopola shifts+absences. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-02-admin-editor-turni-design.md (sez. 6.6). Dipendenze: draftStorage/exportImport, ShiftGrid, AbsencePanel, MonthPicker.

validation.criteria: VERIFIED (independent review): (1) Autosave - AdminEditor.tsx useEffect (line ~180) calls draftStorage.saveDraft(monthData) on every change (skips while a draft prompt is pending or grid is empty); loadDraft(month) computed as pendingDraft (useMemo) surfaces a Riprendi/Scarta banner when a draft exists and no in-memory state yet; Riprendi calls selectionsFromShifts(config, draft.shifts) + sets absences from draft.absences; Scarta calls clearDraft(month). draftStorage.ts persists under key `ww-turni-draft-<month>`, fails silently if localStorage unavailable. (2) Export - handleExport calls exportImport.exportMonthData(monthData), which serializes {title, month, shifts, absences} via JSON.stringify(month,null,2) and triggers a Blob+anchor download named turni.json; shape matches public/turni.json exactly (verified field names/order). (3) Import - handleImportFile reads the file via FileReader, calls importMonthData (= parseMonthData) which validates title/month/shifts/absences and throws descriptive Errors on malformed input (all caught in try/catch, surfaced as importError state, never crashes); on success reverse-maps imported.shifts via ShiftGrid.selectionsFromShifts(config, shifts) into the flat selections map and sets absences, then jumps to imported.month. (4) Round-trip test at src/components/admin/__tests__/ShiftGrid.test.ts asserts shiftsFromSelections(dateColumns, rows, selectionsFromShifts(config, shifts)) deep-equals the original multi-date, multi-role `shifts` array (genuine inverse-function assertion, plus edge cases: first-free-slot fill order, dropped overflow assignment, empty input). Also src/utils/__tests__/exportImport.test.ts covers serialize/parse round-trip and malformed-field error messages. (5) `.\init.ps1 build` succeeded (tsc -b && vite build, dist/ generated). `npm test` (vitest run): 7 test files, 34/34 tests passed, including the ShiftGrid round-trip test. All 4 acceptance criteria confirmed met.
